name: Wit of the Guarding Statue
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level: jester 6

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Duration: 1 round per level

You infuse life into inanimate matter, conjuring a Large alchemical golem within range. The golem is under your control and will remain for the duration of the spell, at which point it melts away. Additionally, for the duration of the spell, each time you successfully land a hit with a spell that includes the Jest keyword, the alchemical golem is bolstered with 10 temporary hit points.
